strategy: Integrated milestones. Phase 37 starts measurable candidate evolution from observed failures and goals, with identical baseline/candidate tests, repeatable diagnostics, provenance and rollback-ready staging. Production promotion still requires independent evidence.

milestones.name: Self-Awareness & System Intelligence
outcomes: Persistent identity and mission
Static architecture and dependency discovery
Capability registry with evidence-aware statuses
Hardware and runtime resource snapshot
Persistent evolution state, decision ledger, and handoff
exit_criteria: Discovery is read-only and does not import or execute project modules
Capability statuses distinguish discovered, available, degraded, unavailable, and verified
Knowledge files are atomically written and ledger integrity is checkable
A new session can resume from EVOLUTION_STATE.json and HANDOFF.md

milestones.name: Safe Execution & Self-Repair Engine
outcomes: Immutable staging workspace and source-bound snapshots
Transactional candidate patch application and complete rollback
Audited OS sandbox integration with filesystem, process, network, and resource limits
Independent verification, regression, benchmark, and evidence receipts
Human-governed promotion with no self-approval
exit_criteria: Real OS isolation is independently audited; proot alone is not accepted as hostile-code isolation
Candidate code cannot mutate live source during tests
Rollback is tested against tampering, partial writes, and interrupted transactions
Promotion requires current source hashes, trusted attestation, regression evidence, approval, and rollback proof

milestones.name: Autonomous Learning & Cognitive Evolution
outcomes: Self-reflection and root-cause analysis
Episodic, semantic, procedural, failure, and code memory
Continual learning with provenance and correction history
Meta-learning to evaluate and improve learning strategies
Knowledge-gap detection and autonomous goal proposals
Bounded autonomous planning with resource and permission budgets
exit_criteria: Learning records are evidence-backed and replay trust is checked
Memory supports correction, supersession, deduplication, and provenance
Goal proposals include rationale, expected value, cost, risk, and verification plan
The system measures task correctness and resource cost, not just self-reported success

milestones.name: Recursive Evolution & Adaptive Architecture
outcomes: Recursive source and architecture analysis
Dynamic tool and module creation with permission manifests
Adaptive model, agent, and routing selection
Hardware-aware model and runtime optimization
C++ and Rust extension build pipeline
Evolution monitoring, recovery, and long-term evaluation
exit_criteria: New tools and modules are staged, sandbox-tested, reviewed, and reversible
Architecture changes preserve interface and regression compatibility
Optimizations are benchmarked against a stable baseline
Long-term evaluation detects regressions, forgetting, and capability degradation

milestones.name: Verified Candidate Evolution
outcomes: Evidence-led candidate discovery from execution reflection and architecture goals
Hash-pinned candidate staging outside the live source tree
Baseline-versus-candidate regression experiments using the local diagnostic runner
Functional and performance comparison with explicit regression detection
Append-only experiment reports and reproducible test/source provenance
Explicit promotion decision remains blocked until production attestation is deployed
Automatic evidence-backed experiment memory from each candidate evaluation
Idempotent, recoverable memory and ledger projections with report/payload hashes
exit_criteria: Candidate staging changes only the declared file and records the exact baseline hash
Baseline and candidate execute the same byte-identical pinned tests
Stale baselines, modified candidates, changed tests and malformed runner results are rejected
A candidate regression is surfaced and never described as an improvement
Every local run is labelled UNVERIFIED_LOCAL, unattested and not promotion eligible
A later OS-isolated run can consume the same candidate and test manifest without changing the candidate identity

sub_milestones.name: Repeatable Candidate Experiments
outcomes: Hash-pinned baseline and candidate snapshots
Three paired local diagnostic runs
Regression and median performance comparison
Append-only experiment ledger and reports

sub_milestones.name: Failure-Driven Candidate Discovery
outcomes: Live failure reflection joined with diagnostic signatures
Stable discovery IDs bound to event and task hashes
Raw issue text excluded from the queue
Native proposal staging bound to exact source and pinned tests

sub_milestones.name: Evidence-Backed Experiment Memory
outcomes: Automatically capture local candidate experiment reports into durable memory
Validate per-run outcomes, summaries, source/test hashes and decision consistency
Bind report and payload hashes into an append-only journal
Recover interrupted memory/ledger projections idempotently
Preserve UNVERIFIED trust and block replay/promotion
exit_criteria: Every completed candidate-evaluation report is automatically offered to evidence-backed memory capture
Reports with invalid source/test hashes, pytest command, run summaries, performance threshold, or decision are rejected
Journal records bind exact report and canonical payload SHA-256 digests
Interrupted memory/ledger projections recover idempotently without duplicate evidence
Status verifies journal integrity and exact consistency with Experience Memory and Evolution Ledger projections
Local evidence remains UNVERIFIED_LOCAL, unattested, non-replayable, and not promotion eligible
Human approval and independent OS attestation remain required for any future production promotion
